# Original failed Chrome evidence

These seven files are byte-identical copies of the ninth dash entry from the
`YAt03b` parent report (Chrome 154.0.8037.57, Node v26.9.0). `manifest.json`
records the original report identity, hashes, model intent and measurement units.

This is the failed `.5` scale observation: 96 missing candidates and an
undersized selection circle. The entry's pointer actions had not run. The
registered geometry regression reuses all 1,089 independent native grid cells;
it does not turn this failed historical run into fresh browser acceptance.
Corrected native artifacts are written to the new verifier's external directory.

The adjacent `dash-cap-svg` fixtures retain their distinct librsvg/Cairo origin.
